results.answer: US blog and content writing services are priced at about $150–$600 per blog post (Clutch, Sept 2026). Mid-range writing runs $0.15–$0.50/word or $250–$800 per post, and retainers start around $1,800/month (eesel, Feb 2026). The EFA's 2025-rate survey puts ghostwritten blog posts at 25–40¢/word. AI article tools cost about $2–$4 per article and $9–$199/month. No source states a margin for an AI-content resale service.

results.answer: Market estimates for human-delivered VA services put the market at about $5.3B in 2025, projected to reach $6.5B in 2026 (Fact.MR via Wishup, Sept 2026); another firm's 2025 base is far larger. SMBs are reported as 44.4% of clients, and 37% of small businesses delegate some processes externally. No Minneapolis-specific demand data, and no data on demand for automated VA services specifically, was found.

facts.claim: Wishup's 2026 VA industry report (Sept 2026), citing Fact.MR, estimates the VA services market at USD 5.3 billion in 2025, projected to reach USD 6.5 billion in 2026 and USD 43.4 billion by 2035 (23.4% CAGR).
facts.quote: The market size for VA services in 2025 is estimated at USD 5.3 billion.

facts.claim: Wishup's report, citing Teamstage, says 37% of small businesses delegate at least part of their business processes to external providers.

results.notes: Market-size estimates conflict sharply (Fact.MR USD 5.3B vs FMI USD 19.5B for 2025). Wishup is a VA vendor. No data was found on demand for automated or AI-delivered VA services, or on Minneapolis local demand.

results.answer: US VAs average about $19.71/hr in 2026 (range $13–$30, Payscale). Offshore (Philippines) managed VAs cost about $12–$19/hr effective, versus $25–$50/hr for US VAs. Full-time packages run about $1,988–$3,000/month, and hour buckets run $390 for 10 hours to $2,160 for 60 hours. Offshore generalist rates of about $8–$20/hr compare with onshore rates of about $25–$45+/hr.

results.answer: Only indirect demand evidence was found. Shopify grew revenue 34% in Q1 2026, with over $100B GMV in the quarter, and nearly 7 million live stores use Shopify (Nov 2026). No direct measure of demand for third-party store setup or management services was found.

results.answer: A 2026 Shopify store setup costs about $2,000–$10,000 with a freelancer or small studio and $8,000–$50,000+ with an agency. Ongoing support plans typically run a few hundred dollars per month. Shopify freelancer rates run about $15/$33/$95 per hour by Upwork tier, and US agency rates about $100–$149/hr. No firm published monthly management price list was found.
